description: Globally unique participant identifier (source: participant_ID in original data; e.g. Perception_ID_0001)
Participant age in years (source: Age in original data)
Participant self-reported gender (source: Sex in original data)
The English word being rated (source: Word in original data)
1-based index of the word within the participant's session within the norming component
Rating of how strongly the word is experienced by hearing (0 = not at all; 5 = greatly; NA = no response recorded)
Rating of how strongly the word is experienced by tasting (0 = not at all; 5 = greatly; NA = no response recorded)
Rating of how strongly the word is experienced by feeling through touch (0 = not at all; 5 = greatly; NA = no response recorded)
Rating of how strongly the word is experienced by sensations inside the body (0 = not at all; 5 = greatly; NA = no response recorded)
Rating of how strongly the word is experienced by smelling (0 = not at all; 5 = greatly; NA = no response recorded)
Rating of how strongly the word is experienced by seeing (0 = not at all; 5 = greatly; NA = no response recorded)
Rating of how strongly the word is experienced by performing an action with the foot or leg (0 = not at all; 5 = greatly; NA = no response recorded)
Rating of how strongly the word is experienced by performing an action with the hand or arm (0 = not at all; 5 = greatly; NA = no response recorded)
Rating of how strongly the word is experienced by performing an action with the head excluding mouth (0 = not at all; 5 = greatly; NA = no response recorded)
Rating of how strongly the word is experienced by performing an action with the mouth or throat (0 = not at all; 5 = greatly; NA = no response recorded)
Rating of how strongly the word is experienced by performing an action with the torso (0 = not at all; 5 = greatly; NA = no response recorded)
Whether the participant indicated not knowing the meaning of the word (0 = knows the word; 1 = does not know the word; source: Dont_know_word in original data)
